findings.title: Climate presets auto and economy are non-standard and have no translation or icon in any language
findings.claim: The climate entity publishes preset_modes [auto, comfort, economy, boost]; auto and economy are not Home Assistant standard presets and the entity has no translation_key, so 2 of its 4 presets are untranslated in en and sv and have no icon.
findings.mechanism: HA's climate component translates/icons only PRESET_* (none, eco, away, boost, comfort, home, sleep, activity); a custom preset needs entity.climate.<translation_key>.state_attributes.preset_mode.state in strings/translations and icons.json, and HeatPumpOptimizerClimate (main-feature entity, _attr_name None) sets no translation_key and no entity.climate section exists.

evidence.unit: presets untranslated (en; sv and icons also 2)
evidence.machine: 4-CPU Linux cloud container (shared audit box B2), Python 3.14.0rc2
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running (load1 4.2-4.4); count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb translate: in-memory translation_key plus preset_mode state/icon tables for auto and economy (also --perturb eco: rename economy to HA-standard eco -> 1)

findings.metric_definition: Count of the climate entity's preset_modes that are neither HA-standard presets nor present in entity.climate.<translation_key>.state_attributes.preset_mode.state of translations/en.json.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every enumerated value the integration publishes into a climate state attribute HA translates (preset_mode, hvac/fan/swing modes) is either an HA-standard constant or translated in every shipped language and iconed under the entity's translation_key.

null_control.note: the same measurement with the translation tables present reads 0, so the count is the missing tables, not the harness

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Give HeatPumpOptimizerClimate a translation_key (keeping _attr_name None) and add entity.climate.<key>.state_attributes.preset_mode.state for auto/economy (or all four) in strings.json, translations/en.json, translations/sv.json and icons.json; or map economy to HA's eco. Update quality_scale.yaml rows entity-translations/icon-translations accordingly.
